cliHelpCommand.stdoutHead:
usage: jobspy [QUERY] [options]

Search job boards and print one JSON object per job (JSON Lines) on stdout.
Fields a board did not give are left out.
Default: 5 jobs from each of 4 boards; --site picks boards, -n sets the count.
Errors and warnings go to stderr.

examples:
  jobspy "software engineer" --site indeed,linkedin --location Chicago -n 20
  jobspy nurse --site indeed,linkedin --hours-old 24 -o jobs.jsonl
  jobspy "data analyst" --remote --fields title,company,job_url

exit codes:
  0    at least one board answered, also with no jobs
  1    every board failed
  2    usage error
  130  interrupted

options:
  -h, --help                  show this help message and exit
  -V, --version               show program's version number and exit

search:
  QUERY                       search term
  --location TEXT             city, state or country
  --distance N                miles (default 50)
  --remote                    remote jobs only
  --job-type T                one of the job types below
  --hours-old N               posted in the last N hours
  --easy-apply                jobs hosted on the board
  --country-indeed C          Indeed and Glassdoor (default usa)
  -n, --results-wanted N      per board (default 5)
  --offset N                  skip the first N results

boards:
  --site LIST                 comma list (default: see board names below)
  --fetch-description         fetch each job's page (one request per job)
  --description-format F      markdown (default), html, plain
  --enforce-annual-salary     convert pay to yearly
  --linkedin-company-ids IDS  LinkedIn company ids
  --proxies LIST              a URL, a comma list, or a file with one per line
  --ca-cert PATH              CA bundle for the proxy
  --user-agent TEXT           User-Agent header

output:
  --fields LIST               see below
  -o, --output FILE           also save full records (.csv, .json or .jsonl)

diagnostics:
  stderr shows warnings by default

  -q, --quiet                 errors
  -v, --verbose               info

board names:
  indeed, linkedin, zip_recruiter, glassdoor (default)
  bayt (Middle East), naukri (India), bdjobs (Bangladesh), hellowork (France)

job types:
  fulltime, parttime, contract, temporary, internship, perdiem, other,
  volunteer

default fields:
  site, title, company, location, date_posted, job_type, is_remote,
  min_amount, max_amount, currency, interval, job_url

other fields (--fields takes any of these, or all):
  id, job_url_direct, salary_source, job_level, job_function, listing_type,
  emails, description, company_industry, company_url, company_logo,
  company_url_direct, company_addresses, company_num_employees,
  company_revenue, company_description, skills, experience_range,
  company_rating, company_reviews_count, vacancy_count, work_from_home_type

truthBoundary: This proves pinned package acquisition/import and advertised local entry points only. It does not prove any job board is reachable, permits scraping, has fresh vacancies, or will remain compatible.
